title: Anointing of the Holy Spirit
definition: Anointing of the Holy Spirit refers to the Spirit's consecrating and teaching work by which believers are set apart for God and guarded in truth.
summary: The Spirit anoints God's people, setting them apart and teaching them truth.
christFocus: Jesus is the Anointed One, and His people share in His life and mission by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
In Scripture, anointing is associated with consecration, empowerment, and God's appointed work. Jesus is the Christ, the Anointed One, filled with the Spirit for His mission.

Believers are also anointed by the Spirit in a derivative way. The Spirit teaches, guards, and sets them apart for God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people misuse the language of anointing for status or control. This doctrine matters because the Spirit's anointing belongs to God's truth and mission, not self-exaltation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive the Spirit's teaching with humility. Serve as one set apart for God, not as one seeking spiritual superiority.
